facts.fact: The AU-IPED peer review report says the Ministry of Education has initiated reforms to digitise its EMIS, moving from paper-based EMIS 1.0 to a digitised, integrated EMIS 2.0, with a three-year USD 4.5 million plan proposed.
The report says the last national school census was conducted in 2022 at a cost of USD 1 million, funded by partners, with no new data collected since.

systems.platform: ODK for data collection; DHIS2 integration planned
systems.tiers: national, with county EMIS hubs planned in 15 counties
